title: Study anchor
description: Source location in one published chapter. offset is a zero-based Unicode code-point position in the published verse text (including its end position). If alignment is unresolved, offset is absent: consumers must not guess. A reference inside a footnote also identifies note and note_offset in that footnote text; the verse location remains its attachment to Scripture. scope introduction requires verse 0 and an introduction index; offset then addresses that introduction text. scope source retains an original verse not emitted as display text and always uses unresolved alignment.

scope.description: introduction locates chapter introduction text; source retains a verse with no published display text and unresolved alignment. Absent for an emitted verse.

introduction.description: Zero-based entry index in the chapter introduction array.
